WorkspaceState.title: WorkspaceState
WorkspaceState.description: User private workspace state including rules, column configs, workbooks meta, results meta, sync history and sharing pointers

uploading.description: Flag indicating if a multi-chunk upload is currently in progress

chunkCount.description: Number of chunks stored in the subcollection

entries.description: Array of sync history log items

clearedAt.description: Timestamp when sync history was last cleared

WorkspaceChunk.title: WorkspaceChunk
WorkspaceChunk.description: Individual UTF-8 data chunk for chunked workspace state documents

uploadId.description: Upload session token to ensure chunk consistency

SharedPreview.title: SharedPreview
SharedPreview.description: Public or shared matching preview metadata allowing read access without authentication

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who published the preview

comparisonWbName.description: Name of the incoming comparison workbook

chunkCount.description: Total count of payload chunks in the subcollection

SharedPreviewChunk.title: SharedPreviewChunk
SharedPreviewChunk.description: Individual UTF-8 data chunk for shared public preview

uploadId.description: Upload session token to avoid mixing concurrent uploads

TestConnection.title: TestConnection
TestConnection.description: Health check document to verify Firestore network connectivity

/workspaces/{userId}/state/{stateDoc}.description: Stores private user workspace configuration, presets, workbooks metadata, and history

/workspaces/{userId}/state/{stateDoc}/ch.description: Stores chunks of private workspace payloads

/shares/{shareId}.description: Stores publicly accessible preview metadata published by users

/shares/{shareId}/chunks/{chunkId}.description: Stores chunks of publicly readable shared preview payloads
